newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 341 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 341 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 341 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
It allotted 330 million stg in repos to August 6 and 11 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before August 6.
The Bank has now provided liquidity totalling 1.481 billion stg in response to a forecast money market shortage of 1.75 billion stg.
